{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Data shape:", data.shape)
print("\nColumns:", data.columns.tolist())
print("\nFirst few rows:\")
print(data.head())

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]
print(f"\nNumber of patients with multiple rows: {len(duplicate_patients)}")
print(f"Patients with duplicates: {list(duplicate_patients.index)}")

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"\nNumber of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {(data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")

# Check for assay_batch unit error
print(f"\nUnique assay_batch values: {data['assay_batch'].unique()}")
print(f"\nAssay batch B values (should be divided by 10): {data[data['assay_batch'] == 'B']['biomarker_final'].describe()}")

# Check arm and severity values
print(f"\nUnique arms: {data['arm'].unique()}")
print(f"\nUnique severity levels: {data['severity'].unique()}")

# Check responded values
print(f"\nUnique responded values: {data['responded'].unique()}")"}
